inspect.description: Inspect canonical request parameters, budget, approval state, and gate status without network calls.

prepare.description: Generate a new OfficialScheduleAcquisitionRequest with unique ID, timestamp, expiration, and canonical digest.

approval-status.description: Read TrustedApprovalStore and display authorization state without leaking secret key bytes.

execute.description: Execute acquisition only under verified authorization and runtime gate. Fails closed on violations.

verify.description: Verify vaulted official evidence against 12 cryptographic and parsing checks without network access.

revoke.description: Revoke an authorization token in TrustedApprovalStore with persistent audit trail.
